name: qwen-image-local
description: Install, manage, and run Qwen-Image (open-source image generation model) locally via ComfyUI, entirely from VS Code.

commands.title: Qwen-Image: Run Full Setup (Install + Download + Launch)

qwenImage.installDir.description: Folder where ComfyUI will be installed. Defaults to a folder in your home directory if left blank.

qwenImage.pythonPath.description: Command used to invoke Python (e.g. 'python', 'python3', or a full path).

qwenImage.quantVariant.description: Which quantization to download. Lower = smaller/faster but lower quality. Q2_K/Q3_K_S for 8GB VRAM, Q4_K_M for 12GB+, FP8 for 16GB+.

qwenImage.hfRepoGGUF.description: Hugging Face repo id for the GGUF quantized checkpoint. Change this if the model has moved or you prefer a different maintainer's build.

qwenImage.hfRepoTextEncoder.description: Hugging Face repo id containing the text encoder + mmproj files.

qwenImage.hfRepoVAE.description: Hugging Face repo id containing the VAE file (must be the ComfyUI-format VAE, matching the UNet's architecture).
